QuestInfo.name: Eliminate the Drakes
QuestInfo.0: Muirhat is worried about the evil spirits that have infiltrated Victoria Island as of late. I wonder what I could do to help. I should go see Muirhat on the top deck of The Nautilus.
QuestInfo.1:
Victoria Island has already been infused with evil spirits. But I refuse to give up like this. I need to eliminate #r50 Drakes#k and #r50 Ice Drakes#k to stop these evil creatures from further spreading their evilness in Victoria Island. 

#o 5130100# #r#a22022##k
#o 6230600# #r#a22021##k
QuestInfo.2: I've eliminated 50 Red Drakes and 50 Ice Drakes. I wonder if I've made a difference in Victoria Island.

0.0: Thank you for the wonderful job you did last time. Unfortunately, I don't think that was enough to prevent the evil spirits from reaching further. Can you help me once more?

yes.0: Thank you. This time, it's #r50 Red Drakes#k and #r50 Ice Drakes#k. They are much more powerful than the Skeletons you faced last time. Please take care of yourself.

no.0: You must be busy with other endeavors. That's unfortunate. I'll just have to look for other willing warriors.

1.0: That was fast. I knew you'd be able to do it. Hopefully your efforts will result in bringing in peace on Victoria Island.

yes.0: Once you make yourself more powerful, I'll contact you again for more help.

mob.0: Please defeat 50 Red Drakes and 50 Ice Drakes. They can be found in the deepest part of Victoria Island.
